intro.text: Prophetic utterances spoken by some people as they die.

description.text: The futures they describe are not inevitable: Sigzil escaped the ending foretold for him.

items.text: Deti spoke a Death Rattle as he died during the defense.
Leyten's final words foretold Sigzil and Vienta dying at Moash's hands.
Sigzil broke his oaths to keep Moash from killing Vienta, then escaped with Bridge Four's help.
